entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Sales', 'Support', or 'Billing' to be routed.
Connecting you to the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I want to return this piece of junk VeloBand I bought. It's useless.
I'm sorry to hear you're not satisfied with your purchase. I can definitely look into the return options for you. Could I start with your name and order number, please?
It's John Smith, order number 788-91B. And don't give me the runaround, I want my money back.

Thank you, John. I'm pulling up your order now... I see the VeloBand Cadence Sensor was delivered on January 5th. I understand you want to return it. To make sure I'm helping you correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

I don't have time to be your quality assurance department! It doesn't track my cadence correctly, it's garbage. Your website says 90 days. Process the return or get me your manager right now. I'm not afraid to post a review about this all over social media.

I understand your frustration, and there's no need for a manager. You are absolutely correct about our return policy. Since you received the item just seven days ago, you are well within the 90-day window for a full refund.
Oh. So you can do it then?

Yes, of course. I've just initiated the return in our system. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to the email address on file right now. You should receive it in the next few minutes. Just print it out and attach it to the original packaging.
Okay. Good. So I just ship it back and I get my money?

That's correct. Once our warehouse receives the return, your refund will be issued back to your original payment method within 3 to 5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with, John?
No, that's it. Just make sure that email comes through.
It's on its way. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
